name: Save by OpenArchive
tagline: Safely preserve, organize, and share your mobile media
blurb: Save (Share Archive Verify Encrypt) by OpenArchive enables you to safely preserve, organize, and share your mobile media.
description:
Save (Share Archive Verify Encrypt) by OpenArchive enables you to safely preserve, organize, and share your mobile media.

* Upload any type of media to a private server or directly to the Internet Archive and the WebDAV Servers.
* Edit media metadata, including location, and additional notes
* Flag media as "significant" for organization and/or easy retrieval later
* Create multiple project albums to keep media organized
* Creative Commons licensing options for the media you collect and share
